Mitochondrial permeability and energy failure

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

After a severe calcium load, isolated mitochondria develop a high-conductance permeability pathway in the inner membrane. The electrochemical gradient collapses even though oxygen is still available in the experimental chamber. Which immediate functional consequence is most likely?

  1. Selective acceleration of DNA replication
  2. Failure of oxidative ATP synthesis
  3. Increased efficiency of ATP synthesis
  4. Direct secretion of collagen into cytoplasm
  5. Increased lysosomal storage capacity
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Failure of oxidative ATP synthesis

Loss of the mitochondrial electrochemical gradient prevents ATP synthase from efficiently generating ATP.

Understanding the options

Failure of oxidative ATP synthesis
Loss of the mitochondrial electrochemical gradient prevents ATP synthase from efficiently generating ATP.
Increased efficiency of ATP synthesis
A collapsed gradient decreases, rather than improves, ATP production.
Direct secretion of collagen into cytoplasm
Collagen secretion is unrelated to the mitochondrial permeability transition.
Increased lysosomal storage capacity
Lysosomal storage does not directly follow loss of mitochondrial potential.
Selective acceleration of DNA replication
Energy failure inhibits many synthetic processes rather than selectively accelerating replication.
